title: Amount Financed by a Home Delivery Pharmacy Payment Plan
content:
## Billing office rule: what the plan finances

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, the amount the plan finances depends on what is already on the balance: when member charges for shipments dated less than one whole month before the handling date are on the account, the plan finances the balance due less those charges, which are billed on their normal terms; when no such charges are present but expedited fees dated less than one whole month before the handling date are, the plan finances the balance due less those fees, which are billed on their normal terms; otherwise the plan finances the whole balance due.

Member charges are those on the account's shipment records; expedited fees are the shipping-fee charges booked on its orders.

### Method by what is on the balance

| Recent member charges (shipments dated less than one whole month before the handling date) | Recent expedited fees (dated less than one whole month before) | Plan finances |
|---|---|---|
| present | present or absent | the balance due less those member charges |
| absent | present | the balance due less those expedited fees |
| absent | absent | the whole balance due |

### Worked cases (hypothetical balance due of 420.00)

1. A shipment dated two weeks ago carried a member charge of 60.00, and an expedited fee of 14.95 is dated the same week. The plan finances 420.00 less 60.00, 360.00; the recent charge is billed on its normal terms.
2. No shipment is dated within the last whole month, but an expedited fee of 22.95 is. The plan finances 420.00 less 22.95, 397.05.
3. Neither is present. The plan finances 420.00.
